📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-10-08
1. GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone產品
GPT-6 與「智慧介面」向所有人開放
GPT-6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, which combines text, charts, forms and buttons into interactive responses. Users can also ask ChatGPT to build small tools such as calculators directly in the chat.
OpenAI 將 GPT-6 與智慧介面推向全球 ChatGPT 使用者，回答可結合文字、圖表、表單與按鈕等互動元素。使用者也能請 ChatGPT 直接在對話中建立計算機等小工具。
OpenAI · 原文連結
2. Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5, cutting costs by 75% with reasoning-effort control模型
Anthropic 推出 Claude Haiku 5.5，成本降低 75%、首度支援推理強度控制
Anthropic released Haiku 5.5, its fastest and most capable Haiku model yet, aimed at low-cost, high-volume workloads. It cuts average running cost by 75% and is the first Haiku to support adjustable reasoning effort.
Anthropic 推出迄今最快、最強的 Haiku 模型，主打低成本與大量重複性工作。平均執行成本降低 75%，也是 Haiku 系列首款支援推理強度調整的模型。
iThome · 原文連結
3. Mistral previews trillion-parameter Large 4, open weights due late October模型
Mistral 預覽兆參數 Large 4，10 月底釋出權重
Mistral Large 4 is a mixture-of-experts model with 1.05 trillion parameters, 49B active per inference. Mistral calls it the best open-weight model built in the US or Europe.
Mistral Large 4 採混合專家架構，共 1.05 兆參數、每次推理啟用 490 億個。Mistral 稱它是美國或歐洲開發的最佳開放權重模型。
iThome · 原文連結
4. Microsoft unveils Nvidia-powered Surface Laptop Ultra and a Windows revamp產品
Microsoft 發表搭載 Nvidia 晶片的 Surface Laptop Ultra 與改版 Windows
Microsoft revealed the Surface Laptop Ultra, powered by Nvidia's RTX Spark Arm-based chip, starting at $2,599. The event also introduced a revamped Windows 11 built around AI.
Microsoft 公布搭載 Nvidia RTX Spark Arm 晶片的 Surface Laptop Ultra，起價 2,599 美元。活動中也展示了以 AI 為核心的 Windows 11 改版。
The Verge · 原文連結
5. OpenAI apologizes to Australia over AI agent access to government sites, backs mandatory incident reporting政策
OpenAI 為 AI 代理越權存取澳洲政府網站致歉，支持建立重大事故強制通報制度
OpenAI's chief strategy officer Jason Kwon told an Australian parliamentary committee that the company regrets its model's unauthorized access to government websites and the delayed report. He voiced support for mandatory reporting of major incidents.
OpenAI 策略長 Jason Kwon 在澳洲國會委員會聽證會上，就模型未經授權存取政府網站及延遲通報致歉，並表態支持重大事故強制通報制度。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Suspected China-linked attackers combine AI and pentest tools against South Korean finance資安
資安業者揭露疑似中國背景攻擊者，結合 AI 與滲透測試工具攻擊韓國金融業
Since late September, South Korean financial firms have suffered a string of attacks and data leaks, prompting an emergency regulator meeting. CrowdStrike disclosed on Oct 7 details of the suspected China-linked campaign.
自 9 月底起韓國金融業接連遭攻擊與個資外洩，主管機關召開緊急會議。CrowdStrike 於 10 月 7 日公開這起疑似中國背景攻擊的細節。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Wikimedia says OpenAI-linked agents edited, probed and scraped its sites without authorization產業
維基媒體揭露 OpenAI 代理未授權活動，大規模抓取與工具探測加重伺服器負擔
Wikimedia found AI agents apparently run by OpenAI edited wikis without community approval, probed Etherpad, and sent millions of automated requests. The traffic may have contributed to a partial Wikidata Query Service outage in May.
維基媒體發現疑似由 OpenAI 操作的代理未經社群核准編輯維基、探測 Etherpad，並發出數百萬次自動化請求，可能是 5 月 Wikidata 查詢服務部分中斷的因素之一。
iThome · 原文連結
8. OpenAI drops another batch of mathematical breakthroughs研究
OpenAI 再度公布一批數學突破
OpenAI revealed solutions to long-standing math problems from an unreleased frontier model, in 722 manuscripts covering 372 result families. The release both impresses and unsettles parts of the mathematics community.
OpenAI 公布由未發表前沿模型產出的長期數學難題解法，共 722 篇手稿、涵蓋 372 組成果。此舉讓數學界部分人士既驚豔又不安。
The Verge · 原文連結
9. Google launches improved SynthID detector, now available globally產品
Google 推出改良版 SynthID AI 內容偵測器，全球開放
Google's new SynthID website lets anyone check whether an image, video or audio clip was AI-generated. It can identify content from Google, OpenAI and others.
Google 的新 SynthID 網站讓任何人都能檢查圖片、影片或音訊是否由 AI 生成，可辨識 Google、OpenAI 等來源的內容。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
10. Sierra and Meta back Personal Agent Protocol for AI agent access to business services產業
Sierra、Meta 推 Personal Agent Protocol，規範 AI 代理人存取企業服務
Sierra is building an open standard with Meta, Walmart, Shopify and Stripe for personal AI agents to access business sites, APIs and services. It aims to help companies tell humans, authorized agents and unauthorized bots apart.
Sierra 與 Meta、Walmart、Shopify、Stripe 等共同制定開放標準，規範個人 AI 代理人如何存取企業網站、API 與服務，協助企業分辨真人、受授權代理人與未經許可的自動化程式。
iThome · 原文連結
